# Arte Sheets — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> Local-first browser spreadsheet powered by a dedicated Web Worker 207-formula calculation engine (financial, statistical, lookup & dynamic-array functions), .xlsx/.ods/.csv/.tsv binary worker I/O, Service Worker offline caching, IndexedDB storage, 22 self-paced spreadsheet courses, and optional German EU cloud collaboration.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/arte-sheets-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-sheets-docs/
- **Platforms**: Web Browser (macOS, Windows, Linux, iPadOS, iOS)
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- 207 Excel-compatible functions across financial (NPV, XNPV, IRR, PMT, IPMT, PPMT), statistical, logical, text, lookup (XLOOKUP, XMATCH, INDEX/MATCH), and dynamic-array spills (FILTER, UNIQUE, SORT, SORTBY, SEQUENCE).
- 22 structured, runnable courses at https://sheets.arte-soft.com/en/courses/ plus 2,950+ worked formula guides.
- Instant zero-signup browser workspace (/app/) with local IndexedDB storage, offline Service Worker shell, and .xlsx/.ods/.csv/.tsv worker import/export.
- Optional Arte Sheets Pro tier with private German EU GDPR cloud sync, multi-dimensional PivotTables, Goal Seek, Macro Studio, and 62 interactive Academy lessons.

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://sheets.arte-soft.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://sheets.arte-soft.com/app/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [22 Guided Spreadsheet Courses](https://sheets.arte-soft.com/en/courses/): Self-paced interactive spreadsheet curriculum.
- [Free Browser Interactive Tools](https://sheets.arte-soft.com/app/): Zero-Signup Browser Spreadsheet (207 Formulas) & 22 Guided Courses.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://sheets.arte-soft.com/compare/): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://sheets.arte-soft.com/en/learn/): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://sheets.arte-soft.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
